title: Differential Diagnosis of Frontotemporal Dementia, Alzheimer's Disease, and Normal Aging Using a Multi-Scale Multi-Type Feature Generative Adversarial Deep Neural Network on Structural Magnetic Resonance Images.
summary: The study reports diagnostic classification performance against clinical diagnoses in its imaging cohort. Performance is cohort- and label-specific; independent prospective clinical validation is not established.
ai_technology: A multiscale, multi-type feature generative adversarial deep network classified structural MRI scans as frontotemporal dementia, Alzheimer disease or normal aging.
organization: School of Engineering Science, Simon Fraser University
